body_markdown:
Overwatch has now been fully rebranded, and Overwatch 2 is no more, and Blizzard is essentially resetting the clock on the game's life cycle.


Now, Season 1 of Overwatch is here, and those returning to the game are going to want to know all they can about Competitive.


Here's all we know.


## Overwatch Season 1 Competitive Rewards: All We Know, Cosmetics, Ranks and More


Blizzard releasing five new heroes at the onset of Season 1 was something that no one expected, but here we are.


Now, some brand new heroes are coming, including Jetpack Cat; an adorable new Support for players to try out.


Now, going into the new season; Blizzard has announced the following cosmetic rewards:


*Season 1 marks the start of a new competitive year! This means a competitive reset as well as the new Crimson Wolf competitive weapon, to honor Talon’s new leader. **We’re also giving those who reach Diamond or higher a new Doomfist competitive skin.***


*Competitive titles will now have rarity applied, and Top 500 players will earn dynamic titles for their finishes. Titles from Season 20 and Season 1 will be granted when the title update goes live in Season 2.**
